faq.q: Does it work with Follow Up Boss?
faq.a: Yes. Every plan includes a Zapier link (Zapier is an app that connects apps): each new lead and booking can add a contact and a to-do in Follow Up Boss. On the Business plan, we can also set up a direct link to Follow Up Boss for you, on request. Booking into Google Calendar (free) or Calendly (with your own paid Calendly plan) is included too.

faq.q: Can it answer questions about my listings?
faq.a: It answers from the facts you give it (address, status, open house times, your FAQ). It won't guess about price changes, offers or property condition. It hands those to you.
